message: packageManager in package.json (line 4) pins yarn@4.18.1, but Node.js 26 in .nvmrc does not come with Corepack (Node.js 25.0.0 stopped distributing it), and Corepack is what reads that pin: without a separate Corepack install, yarn there is whatever Yarn is installed, or none
fix: Install Corepack wherever Node.js 26 is used for this project (npm install -g corepack, then corepack enable), as the Corepack README says for a Node.js without it
